Game Overview

In Reflection FX, the core idea is straightforward: command a bouncing ball on a strategic mission in Reflection FX. Master precision, timing, and reflections in smooth gameplay that intensifies with each level. Predict paths, harness angles, and sharpen your skills for endless entertainment. Simple controls and sophisticated physics make every shot a satisfying challenge.
